title: Starting Amount of a Protested Statement and the Employer's Financing Class
content:
For a written protest under Employer Benefit Charging that disputes the employer's base-period wages or its base-period status, the starting amount of the protested statement depends on how the employer finances benefits, as its Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts record shows.

## Rule

Where the employer finances benefits by reimbursement and has been billed for the statement's quarter, the starting amount is the amount billed for that quarter; where the employer is contributory and the quarter's charges have been posted to its reserve account, the starting amount is the amount posted to the reserve for that quarter; in any other case the starting amount is the total of the charges the statement lists, each at its posted amount.

The statement's quarter is the quarter of the statement of benefit charges whose charges are protested.

## Records read

| What is read | Where it is shown |
|---|---|
| How the employer finances benefits | The financing class of the employer's Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts record: a class beginning "Reimbursing —" (Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization, Reimbursing — Governmental Entity) finances by reimbursement; a class beginning "Contributory —" is contributory |
| Amount billed for the quarter | The total of the reimbursement bills entered on the tax account for that quarter |
| Amount posted to the reserve for the quarter | The total of the benefit charges of that quarter posted against the employer's reserve account on the tax account |
| Charges the statement lists | The benefit charges posted to the position in the statement's quarter, each at its posted amount |

## Decision table

| Financing class | Billed, or posted to reserve, for the statement's quarter | Starting amount |
|---|---|---|
| Reimbursing | Billed (an amount above zero) | The amount billed for that quarter |
| Reimbursing | Not billed | The total of the charges the statement lists |
| Contributory | Charges posted to the reserve (an amount above zero) | The amount posted to the reserve for that quarter |
| Contributory | Nothing posted to the reserve | The total of the charges the statement lists |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Reimbursing — Nonprofit Organization employer was billed $1,180.00 for the statement's quarter, while the statement lists charges of $1,174.60. The starting amount is $1,180.00.
- A Contributory — Experience-Rated Positive Reserve employer had $2,045.30 of the quarter's charges posted to its reserve; the statement lists $2,051.10. The starting amount is $2,045.30.
- A contributory employer whose reserve shows no posting for the quarter takes the statement's listed charges.
